name: Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops
benefit:
> **Monetary Assistance:**

- **General Farmers:** 50% of unit cost or ₹80,000/- per hectare- **SC/ST Farmers:** 75% of unit cost or ₹1,20,000/- per hectare- **Devipoojak Farmers:** 90% of cost or ₹46,800/- per hectare
> **Input Support:**

- **Wood/Bamboo Supports:** 1,600 units per hectare- **GI Wire (12–18 gauge) or Plastic Wire:** 400 kg per hectare- **Recommended Plant Spacing:** 2.5 x 2.5 me
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a farmer - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be engaged in vegetable cultivation. - The applicant should be willing to construct trellis mandaps.
